newsitem.title: UK: Abbey has no comment on Cater report.
newsitem.headline: Abbey has no comment on Cater report.

text.p: Abbey National on Monday declined to comment on press reports that it will enter the bidding for financial services group Cater Allen Holdings Plc.
"Those reports are speculative and we don't comment on speculation," a spokeswoman for the bank told Reuters.
Abbey was recently linked with National Westminster Bank Plc in merger rumours and admitted that it had talked to NatWest before calling off discussions.
Last week, financial services group Gerrard and National was linked with Cater, which is thought to be worth at least 200 million stg.
